benchmark_scope: Both engines use the same nested samples of all source records on projected Parquet. Uncached means no application-level data cache; operating system disk cache was not flushed. Spark cache materialization times the read and cache action separately. One discarded warm-up run precedes timing in each engine. Medians are based on 5 repeats per condition. The Spark cache holds only the columns the workload reads. Pandas streams Arrow batches.
